name: @ru-code/e2e
description: Real-Chrome Playwright harness: the real app driven against the fake ACP CLI. Deliberately has NO `test` script — `vp run -r test` (the gates) must never require a browser; run via `pnpm --filter @ru-code/e2e test:core` (or test:contracts / test:warm / test:performance / test:outdated / test:pixso).

scripts.test:core: pnpm e2e:clean-up && playwright test -c playwright.config.ts && pnpm e2e:clean-up
scripts.test:contracts: pnpm e2e:clean-up && playwright test -c playwright.contracts.config.ts && pnpm e2e:clean-up
scripts.test:warm: pnpm e2e:clean-up && playwright test -c playwright.warm.config.ts && pnpm e2e:clean-up
scripts.test:performance: pnpm e2e:clean-up && playwright test -c playwright.performance.config.ts && pnpm e2e:clean-up
scripts.test:outdated: pnpm e2e:clean-up && playwright test -c playwright.outdated.config.ts && pnpm e2e:clean-up
scripts.test:pixso: pnpm e2e:clean-up && playwright test -c playwright.pixso.config.ts && pnpm e2e:clean-up
